BrochureContent.Content:
Truly magnificent property, standing on c. 3 acres (1.21 Ha) of stunning mature gardens less than a 3 minute drive from Gorey town and the M11 motorway.

This palatial property extending to c. 415M2 (4465 sq. ft.), and presented in absoultely pristine decorative order throughout, is undoubtedly one of the most impressive residential properties to come to the market in the North Wexford area in recent years.  Approached by a sweeping avenue through its idyllic gardens and protected by imposing electronic gates and CCTV it exudes a truly singular chateau – style aura of privacy and tranquillity.

On entering the residential property one is immediately aware of the extent and character of this unique home.  From the impressive entrance hallway with its imposing double–turn stairway, to the characterful Living Room, Sitting Room, Dining Room and Kitchen this delightful property exudes class and character at every turn. From the huge mezzanine and four large en-suite bedrooms the stunning views across the property and surrounding countryside enhance the feeling of tranquility and privacy of this truly unique property.  While the manicured lawns and gardens with their wonderful range of mature trees shrubs and orchard are indeed idyllic, the extent and configuration of the land would lend itself to any number of agricultural / horticultural enterprises – e.g., for a family with equestrian interests the land to the rear and sides of the residence would adapt easily to fabulous paddocks and schooling grounds. Furthermore, the large slated block built outbuildings, extending to c. 75M2 (c. 807 sq. ft.) and 32M2 (344 sq. ft.) also have enormous potential for a variety of uses.

The vibrant town of Gorey is less than a 3 minute drive away while there are numerous beaches and two golf courses within 5 minutes of the property.  Junction 23 of the M11 motorway is only a 3 minute drive with commuting time to South Dublin approximately 45 minutes.

Properties of this extent and quality in such a highly sought-after location rarely come to the market.

Early viewing highly recommended.
